claims.text: The hotel sits opposite Green Park, steps from Buckingham Palace.

findings.quote: Opposite Green Park. Steps from Buckingham Palace.

claims.text: The Athenaeum has welcomed guests to this corner of London since 1850.

findings.quote: The Athenaeum has been welcoming curious people to this corner of London since 1850.

claims.text: Many rooms and suites face Green Park or look over the rooftops of Mayfair, with Art Deco details.

findings.quote: Many of our spacious hotel rooms and suites face Green Park or look out over the rooftops of Mayfair, with the Art Deco details

claims.text: The View Penthouse suites on the 10th floor have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the London skyline.

findings.quote: Book a stay in our new 10th floor suites for the best views our London's skyline.
Floor to ceiling windows immerse the space in light and frame unparalleled views of London’s iconic skyline.

claims.text: The 10th-floor suites have British-made Paul Smith toiletries, a partnership exclusive to those suites.

findings.quote: all with British-made Paul Smith toiletries. A new partnership exclusive to our 10th floor suites.

claims.text: View Penthouse suite guests are greeted on arrival by a personal concierge, reachable 24/7.

findings.quote: On arrival you will be greeted by your personal concierge. A dedicated number giving you 24/7 access is printed on your keycard wallet.

claims.text: The Spa at The Athenaeum offers calm treatments using natural British products.

findings.quote: In a city that never pauses, The Spa at The Athenaeum is a place to restore. Calm treatments, natural British products

claims.text: The spa has a steam room and relaxation space, and in-room treatments are available.

findings.quote:
- Steam room and relaxation space
- In-room treatments available

claims.text: The gym is open 24 hours, with Peloton and Technogym equipment.

findings.quote: The gym is open 24-hours. Peloton and Technogym, whenever you need them.

claims.text: 116 at The Athenaeum serves modern British dining and is open to guests and locals.

findings.quote: 116 at The Athenaeum - modern British dining, open to guests and locals

claims.text: The Terrace on Piccadilly is framed by a living wall that the hotel describes as the oldest of its kind in London.

findings.quote: Set directly on Piccadilly, our terrace offers a front-row view of Mayfair life
Framed by our living wall, the oldest of its kind in London

claims.text: The concierge team can secure event tickets, tables at exclusive restaurants or private art gallery showings.

findings.quote: They are connected to all the right people in the city to secure tickets to events, a table at an exclusive restaurant or even a private art gallery showing.

claims.text: Both View Penthouse suites have private balconies looking over Green Park towards Buckingham Palace.

findings.quote: Yes, both suites have private balconies that are accessed from your room. Enjoy the best view in London, over Green Park towards Buckingham Palace and beyond.

claims.text: Green Park Suites have floor-to-ceiling views over Green Park and separate living spaces.

findings.quote: With floor-to-ceiling views of Green Park and separate living spaces, our Green Park Suites capture the highlights of our locality.

claims.text: The townhouse residences have a proper kitchen, a separate sitting room and the full attention of the hotel team.

findings.quote: Our eighteen townhouse residences are something different: a proper kitchen, a separate sitting room and the full attention of the hotel team whenever you need it.

claims.text: The concierge team keeps kites and bikes for families who want an afternoon in the park.

findings.quote: The concierge team keep kites and bikes for families who want an afternoon in the park

claims.text: Spa treatments are offered in partnership with skincare brand Temple Spa.

findings.quote: Discover our range of luxurious spa treatments in partnership with award-winning skincare brand Temple Spa

claims.text: A service charge is added to the bill unless the guest asks for it not to be.

findings.quote: so we have added a 5% service charge to your bill. If you prefer it not to be added, just let us know.
